missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Воля' is feminine nominative as the subject in this possession frame. 'Сильная' is the agreeing feminine adjective, and 'у него' shows whose will it is.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Волю' is the feminine accusative direct object of 'закаляет'. Sport hardens the will.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Воли' is the feminine genitive after 'против'. 'Моей' agrees in the feminine genitive, marking the will it went against.
Strategic focus: Dative object. 'Воле' is the dative form after 'подчинился', which governs the dative. 'Чужой' agrees in the feminine dative.
Strategic focus: Genitive in a set phrase. 'Воли' is the genitive form in 'силой воли', a fixed expression meaning by willpower. A strong idiom for determination.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Воле' uses the prepositional form after 'на' in this figurative phrase. 'Его' marks whose will holds everything together.
Strategic focus: Accusative in an idiom. 'Волю' is the feminine accusative after 'на' in 'на волю', meaning into freedom. A classic idiomatic sense of the word.
Strategic focus: Genitive of relation. 'Воли' is the genitive form in 'свобода воли', the philosophical term free will. It modifies 'свобода' as the subject.

missions.phrase: Воля к победе важна в спорте.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Воля' is the feminine nominative subject. 'К победе' uses the dative to express what the will is directed toward.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Воля' is feminine nominative in this possession frame. 'Такая' agrees in the feminine, and the question asks where such will comes from.
